basis: The queue's starting corpus is kept unless another corpus that carries the same stroke count follows the dictionary's per-stroke directions more closely, as established in the grade 1 batch 24 re-review and used in the earlier special grade batches. Only differences that change the flagged-stroke count are acted on; a few degrees is noise.

灾.reason: MM leaves the opening dot of 火 just over the threshold (one stroke at 63°); the simplified file draws the same dot at 59°, which is inside the range kept as licensed geometry everywhere else.

腆.reason: Ja writes the inner bars of the 典 body in a different order (two strokes over 60°, max 98°); the simplified file follows the dictionary with no stroke over 17°.

畋.reason: Ja writes the inner bar of 田 after the vertical (two strokes over 60°, max 100°); MM follows the dictionary with no stroke over 18°.
